fullDesc: On October 7, 2023 Hamas fighters attacked Israel, killing about 1,200 people and taking about 250 hostages. Israel responded with a major military campaign in Gaza that caused widespread destruction and a humanitarian crisis.
realFacts: It was the deadliest day for Jews since the Holocaust
Tens of thousands of Palestinians have died
A ceasefire in 2025 allowed some hostages to be freed
The conflict spread to Lebanon and Iran
